duration.text: The Economics at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Bareheaded ID photo within half a year2. High school diploma or pre-graduation certificateIf the applicant is a current student, he/she must submit a pre-graduation certificate from his/her school, stating that the applicant will receive his/her graduation certificate by August 25, 2025.3. Complete high school transcripts4. Proof of language ability5. Passport Personal information page6. Medical Examination Record for Foreigners7. Certificate of No Criminal Record8. affidavit of support9.Other documents that can prove learning ability and comprehensive quality, such as award certificates, published papers, etc.

requirements.text: Non-chinese citizens holding a valid foreign passport with good physical and mental health and excellent academic performance Abide by Chinese laws and regulations and school rules and regulationsThe academic level must meet one of the following conditions:1. Fresh high school graduates recognized by the state shall obtain a high school graduation certificate recognized by the state before admission in the same year, otherwise the admission qualification is invalid.2. A high school diploma recognized by the state.3. Persons who have obtained a bachelor's degree. Age requirements18-35 years oldApplicants who are native English speakers, or who have provided evidence of two or more years of English-taught studies, may not provide evidence of English scores;Applicants whose mother tongue is not English must provide proof of IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80 or above; Or pass the exam organized by the School of International Education of Southwestern University of Finance and Economics.
